# mboostrs

mboostrs provides Rust-powered gradient boosting with mboost semantics.

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("fcela/mboostrs", subdir = "mboostrs")
```

## Example

```r
library(mboostrs)

# Gaussian glmboost
set.seed(42)
n <- 200
x1 <- rnorm(n)
x2 <- rnorm(n)
y <- 0.3 * x1 - 0.1 * x2 + rnorm(n)
df <- data.frame(y = y, x1 = x1, x2 = x2)

fit <- glmboost(y ~ x1 + x2, data = df,
                family = Gaussian(),
                control = boost_control(mstop = 100))
print(fit)
coef(fit)
head(predict(fit))

# Cross-validation to find optimal mstop
cv <- cvrisk(fit)
mstop(cv)
```
